purpose: Exact source-derived legacy numeric ID + metadata to flattening target state rows for the 100 old registrations without a same-name modern identity. Data is mapping evidence only; does not assert every target remains a 26.2 registry identity.
method: Scanned every balanced BlockStateData.register(int, targetState, legacyState...) call; selected target calls whose flattened numeric index is within [legacyNumericId*16, legacyNumericId*16+15]. First create(...) is the output state, and later create(...) values are old aliases as confirmed by register implementation. Exact metadata rows preserve the source expressions and lines.
limits: These are 1.13-era vanilla flattening outputs for old numeric ID + metadata, extracted from current BlockStateData source; they are not a guarantee that every output resource name is still a live 26.2 registry identity after subsequent vanilla renames.
Do not convert this evidence into a universal modern WallBlock equivalence or use modern isSolidRender.
No hit for modern identity/state of skull from this pass: its historical row uses FILTER_ME, so identity remains open.
